quest.title: Bantan Sango Case File: Misdirection
quest.description: Ryuuji from the Bantan Sango Detective Agency seems to have something he needs help with...

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Traveler, we meet again. Thanks to your help last time, Sango is now sure of our culprit's identity.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: But if we want that culprit to go down for real, we still need some preparation.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: While she's dealing with other things. Let's continue the work that we started previously.

choices.text: Looking for trouble with the Treasure Hoarders?

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: That's right. Though that culprit has nothing to do with those Treasure Hoarders...

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Those Treasure Hoarders are up to no good anyway, so we may as well have them "help" us.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Sango has marked out their specific location. It's not far from the city.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: As for matters within the city... Sango has secretly instructed Amano and Mr. Andou to assist us in this operation.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: She has also promised that the credit for solving this case will all go to them, so they'll gladly work with us.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: Leave the thinking and planning to her. Let's just keep up our "correspondence" with those Treasure Hoarders.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: I have also marked the location on your map. Let's get going now.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: That's right. We must make him continue to believe that our target is the Treasure Hoarders.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: This way, Sango will have more time to complete her plan.

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: *chuckles*... Not that those Treasure Hoarders were up to any good anyway...

response.speaker: Ryuuji
response.text: So we may as well enlist their "help."

talks.objective: Go to the Treasure Hoarder camp

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Yeah, we made quite a big ruckus this time too. Amano and Mr. Andou will assist us in letting that thief learn about this in town.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How much longer will this take?

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Not long now. Once Sango is ready, we can close this case.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Here is your payment, Traveler. Thank you for your help.

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: This is the amount assigned by Sango herself, so I believe it should be commensurate. Please take them. We may yet have more work for you in the future.

talks.objective: Go to the Treasure Hoarder camp
Go to the Treasure Hoarder camp

dialogues.speaker: Treasure Hoarder
dialogues.text: It's you people again? Come on! I haven't even done anything yet!

dialogues.speaker: Ryuuji
dialogues.text: Sorry, we have orders to preemptively prevent criminal activities. Let's do this, Traveler.
